title: Product Webscraper For E-commerce Site and Product Image Generator
description:
eBay Product Scraper is a tool that automatically collects product listings from eBay and saves them to a database, turning scattered marketplace data into a structured, queryable dataset.

It is built in Python with Django and uses Selenium to drive the scraping, persisting the results to PostgreSQL alongside a vector database, with a JavaScript/TailwindCSS interface on top.
